content: pidfd (man page verified): Linux 5.3+ pidfd_open returns pollable fd - EPOLLIN when child becomes zombie, EPOLLHUP when reaped; race-free vs PID reuse (fd pins the task) provided SIGCHLD not SIG_IGN/SA_NOCLDWAIT and not reaped elsewhere (else use clone CLONE_PIDFD); reap with waitid(P_PIDFD) to get exit status; pidfd_send_signal for race-free kill; no glibc wrapper (syscall()) though modern runtimes hide this; macOS/BSD equivalent = kqueue EVFILT_PROC NOTE_EXIT; SIGCHLD fallback = self-pipe/signalfd coalescing (signals dont queue - must reap all with WNOHANG loop). Recommendation: pidfd on Linux, kqueue on macOS, both integrate into the event loop with zero extra threads (vs ttyd per-process waitpid thread).
